s: Arc enables instructors and learners to: • easily upload media and publish videos to courses that can be viewed across devices and in multiple playback formats; • experience high-quality, low-latency video playback around the world; • seamlessly create content through integrated webcam and screen capture tools; • interact directly with video content through real-time contextual commenting; • understand exactly how students and employees are engaging with media to help inform video strategy effectiveness; • make video content fully accessible through automatic speech recognition, or ASR, captioning technology; and • manage and share videos between educators, students or employees.
